## What's changed

- Made each paired player the owner of a single active playback session so starting a new item promptly stops its previous local, Discovery, or Tube TV work.
- Released transcoder and stream resources immediately when a player reports stop or completion instead of waiting for an idle timeout.
- Stopped the previous Tube TV channel as soon as a player switches while preserving shared channel encoders that another player is still watching.
- Rejected late Tube TV segment requests from a channel the player has already left.
- Added URL-safe local-library path references so filenames containing literal plus signs, spaces, Unicode, or other query-sensitive characters play correctly.
- Preserved the existing readable local path for backward compatibility and added regression coverage for playback ownership and rewritten tvOS URLs.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
